title: Add consistency guard for AI commentary when snapshot fields are unavailable
body:
### Motivation

- Prevent misleading outputs where structured market snapshot fields (e.g. `volume_ratio`, `turnover_rate`) are missing or `N/A` but AI-generated commentary still states confident volume/turnover conclusions.  
- Keep fixes minimal and local to rendering/notification layer without changing AI prompts, analyzer parsing, or execution/accounting logic.  

### Description

- Add helpers in `NotificationService` to detect missing snapshot metrics (`_is_missing_snapshot_metric`, `_has_missing_volume_snapshot_metrics`) and to heuristically identify volume-related AI text (`_looks_like_volume_commentary`).  
- Implement `_guard_volume_commentary` that selectively downgrades only volume/turnover related AI commentary to a neutral message `量能数据不足（量比/换手率缺失），不做量能结论` when snapshot metrics are unavailable.  
- Apply the guard at render time in dashboard/wechat/daily/single-stock flows by integrating into `_get_conflict_safe_ai_commentary` and volume display paths in `src/notification.py`.  
- Add focused tests in `tests/test_notification_summary_format.py` covering missing-metrics downgrade (dashboard/wechat/single-stock) and preservation when metrics exist.  

### Testing

- Ran the notification summary tests with `python -m pytest tests/test_notification_summary_format.py -q` and observed all tests passing (`42 passed`).  
- New tests verify that when `volume_ratio`/`turnover_rate` are `None`/`N/A`, volume-related AI text is downgraded and explicit volume conclusions are not rendered.  
- New tests also verify that when those snapshot metrics exist, AI commentary is preserved and other notification outputs (dashboard/wechat/single-stock) remain unchanged.

------
